name: Baghjan well No. 5 blowout (Tinsukia; Assam)
location_basis: wikipedia: oilfield point (not the well)
notes: Blowout 27 May 2020; fire from 9 June; well killed 15 November. The published point is a persistent flare (registry source 549); the fire itself is the centroid of the 557 VIIRS detections within 5 km between the published dates (2.7 km WSW; sd ~300 m), used only by check_baghjan.py. The same months of 2019 had 3 detections there.
